fusions.name: Undertow
fusions.desc: Lays a 4-tile current ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags nearby enemies inward. It deals 6 damage to each one it catches and slows it by 25% for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Lazy Bubble
fusions.desc: Blows a drifting bubble that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Shallows
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and your party for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Buoyant Bulk

riders.text: you drift across it without effort
and floating there gives something back
and blows slide off your bulk

fusions.desc: You float and paddle across water and swamp as easily as solid ground.
